answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may earn fees or vote, then randomly challenge its signed work with hidden test cases and slash the bond when it fails. A Sybil operator must lock fresh capital for each fake identity, while splitting influence multiplies the required collateral; a mass of invented agents cannot be created for free. The same rule applies whether agents trade shale, wander for data, or price quartz.
